Author: Sansflaire
Name: FFXIV Miscellaneous Challenges
Description: A tracker for miscellaneous self-imposed FFXIV challenges — combat, exploration, gathering, crafting and social goals. Challenges complete themselves as you play: stand somewhere wearing the right thing, follow a multi-step quest chain, work through an adventure's objectives, or race between two points against the clock. Progress persists per install, and a permanent record means a reset is always recoverable. Commands: /tchallenges
